sm_top.sm: Multiple tankers were struck in the Strait of Hormuz and the US struck an Iranian missile launch site on Qeshm Island.
Houthi forces launched a missile attack targeting Riyadh, causing damage to a skyscraper in the Saudi capital.
Iranian forces targeted oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz with missiles and mines, causing fires and casualties.
Ukrainian strikes damaged the Crimean road bridge, halting traffic in an attack on the span.
The U.S. military returned to having two aircraft carriers stationed in the Middle East.
An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed senior Hamas commander Samir Abu Younis.
Iranian missile and drone attack on the US‑run Ali Al Salem Air Base in Kuwait that killed six service members and injured eleven.
Houthi forces seized control of the Bab al-Mandab Strait area following the withdrawal of Yemeni government forces.
Israel concluded a tank raid and ground operation in Gaza to demolish a Hamas tunnel, and residents returned to ruins.
Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv caused power outages and casualties, with three water-utility workers killed and about 15 injured.
Explosions were reported in Bahrain amid an Iranian drone attack targeting a US base.
The International Court of Justice ruled that the Myanmar military is guilty of genocide against the Rohingya minority.
Houthis advance toward Aden following the withdrawal of government forces from key Red Sea coastal positions.
Intelligence reports of Iranian-planned drone attacks targeting senior US officials and Trump, plus possible dirty bomb or chemical threats, with no confirmed occurrence.
Poland detained suspects in connection with sabotage and terrorist preparation plots.
Saudi-backed forces launched a major attack on Houthi rebels in Yemen.
The US Navy aircraft carrier USS George Washington left the Middle East after a three-month deployment.
Russian missile strikes across Ukraine killed four people, injured 34, and damaged bridges in Kyiv and a hospital in Kharkiv.
Israel carried out airstrikes targeting an underground missile site and weapons shipment in eastern Lebanon's Beqaa Valley.
Iranian Army Air Defence claims to have shot down a US MQ-9 drone over the Strait of Hormuz.
Yemen's Houthi forces claimed missile and drone attacks on a Saudi airport and financial facilities in Riyadh.
Saudi-led coalition airstrikes across Yemen continue, with reports of at least 11 civilians killed.
Russian strikes and drone attacks on Odesa resulted in casualties and property damage.
The Yemeni army reported carrying out over 700 operations against Houthi forces, neutralizing fighters.
Two oil tankers caught fire after striking naval mines east of the Strait of Hormuz, according to the Iranian army.
Saudi‑led coalition aircraft struck Sana'a, destroying a Houthi missile launcher in Dhamar and hitting a missile and drone depot.
Ukraine's Air Force reports air defenses intercepted Russian drones overnight.
Houthi forces claimed missile and drone strikes on multiple sites in Saudi Arabia, including Jizan and King Khalid Air Base.
Ukrainian long-range drones struck a major petrochemical complex in Bashkortostan, Russia.
Footage captured a missile strike hitting an Iranian petrochemical plant.
Ukraine struck the Crimean Bridge using a Ruta Block 1 missile.
Russian forces strike the Odesa region overnight following deadly city attacks.
A Russian military An-12 transport aircraft crashed in Siberia, resulting in the death of all 19 people on board.
The US military carried out self-defense airstrikes on an Iranian missile launch site.
A Russian strike on Dnipro damaged the Austrian consulate building and killed two people.
Russian forces conducted a large-scale missile and drone bombardment across Ukraine, killing at least seven people and injuring 63 others.
Russian MoD claims a massive strike on Ukrainian military-industrial, energy, and port infrastructure.
Iran launched a swarm of 30 kamikaze drones targeting Israel and US military bases.
Russian MoD claims air defense forces intercepted and destroyed 310 Ukrainian drones overnight over multiple regions and seas.
Houthi forces conducted an attack damaging a skyscraper in Saudi Arabia.
